blindSummary:
This state/province falls within the restive mountainous border zone that a foreign home office's country-of-origin note (June 2025) treats as an exception to its general finding of no state-persecution risk in the country, and that several foreign governments name in their most severe travel-warning tier for the zone. The emergency-help network's assessment that there is "no safe life for LGBTIQ+ people" in that zone applies here. The security-and-custom enforcement logic — informal detention, family exposure, violence unmediated by legal process — is the operative risk for a discovered visitor.

No purge infrastructure of the scale documented in the zone's worst neighbour, and no special-permission entry regime, is identified for this state/province. Local risk sits well below the country's severe national baseline — on par with two neighbouring states/provinces, and somewhat better than the two specially-restricted neighbours that carry explicit special-access regimes.
